runtime_budget.new_writer_or_job: none; read path only; no governance history deleted
runtime_budget.read_cost_one_repair: measured in the real chain: one repair issues about 20 Governance list requests and about 5 exact GETs (28 owner requests in total), independent of history length; each list response carries every decision of the target. At 1 year of renewals (365 decisions per pool, about 3 KB each) one list response is about 1.1 MB, so one operator repair reads on the order of 20 x 1.1 MB = 22 MB in-process, held one response at a time; candidate verification is bounded to 16 current decisions, historical rows are only classified. Operator repair is manual and rare; no recurring job reads it
runtime_budget.hard_cap: 4096 rows per list read; beyond it the read signals overflow and discovery fails closed
